name: Group chat
annotation: HIFI-76 · /chat · dark shell (#0A0A0F, top-center amber radial glow rgba(255,94,0,.18)); PodCard room-mission summary and AvatarStack presence sit above a solid message thread; ChatComposer is the dominant focal moment, pinned directly above GlassNavBar and kept visually singular, not one tile among many.

modules.build: Dark status bar (time, signal, battery) over bg #0A0A0F + top radial orange rgba(255,94,0,.18).
Native top bar: [< Back] 'Morning crew' [+ add member] [i info]. 44px targets.

GlassCard r24, border white 8%. Overline 'ROOM MISSION'. Body 'Tempo run together'. MomentumBar 'members joining 4/5' (green #34A853) + ChipProvenance 'synced live'. Chips '[120 group XP]' '[CIA pacing]'. One purple #7F24FF glow.
AvatarStack (5 avatars, 3 online with green presence dots). Right caption '3 online'. 44px target opens members sheet.

SolidCard list, not glass. Left bubble solid #211008: 'Kenji: Tomorrow is tempo day.' Left bubble purple #7F24FF border (estimated · low confidence): 'CIA recap: three members share pace.' InlineArtifactCard ghost pill '[Group tempo mission]' + reply chip '[I can lead]'. Right bubble orange #FF5E00 outline: 'You: I can lead the easy group.' Caption 'CIA is preparing pace...'
GlassCard focal surface r28, orange #FF5E00 glow. Input text placeholder 'Message Morning crew'. 44px targets for [+ attach] and [send ->].
GlassNavBar floating pill (r40): Today · CIA · Goals · Me, 44px targets; no forced active tab, since group chat sits outside the four primary tabs. Home indicator ~y828.

belowFold: Sheet overlays: members info, add member, message actions (long press opens route [77]), revoke CIA recap, report/mute/block, leave group.
SafetyResourceCard and ConsentCard for crisis handoff and shared health/recovery consent, reachable from the group info sheet and the report flow.
imageSlots: HIFI-76-01 - Group chat avatar or social proof placeholders, Balencia warm-dark glass UI asset, privacy-safe, no brand logos, no readable UI text.
trustControls: Group info sheet exposes audience, visibility, membership, export *chat* transcript
Group XP/progress optional, never attached to health/nutrition/sleep compliance; members can hide social comparison from this thread
notes:
Dominant focal moment: ChatComposer sits directly above GlassNavBar, visually singular, not one tile among many.
Data Honesty: messages and the CIA recap bubble carry explicit provenance or 'estimated · low confidence' tags; the room-mission MomentumBar carries ChipProvenance 'synced live'; an empty thread shows an honest-null first-message prompt instead of a fabricated history.
Italic word 'chat' (declared in Visual System) doesn't appear literally in the primary ASCII composition; applied instead to the trust-controls export line ('export *chat* transcript'), the same resolution used in sibling screen 10 (CIA Voice in Chat).
Layout fix: draft left an unaccounted ~176px blank gap between the message thread and composer and omitted the nav bar entirely; extended the message thread through y684 and added an explicit GlassNavBar module (y756-844, matching sibling packets 09/40/74) so the frame fully accounts for 844px with no orphaned whitespace.
Structure fix: draft's belowFold/imageSlots were object arrays and notes was a string array, which do not match this corpus's schema (belowFold/imageSlots are string arrays, notes is a single string) — normalized here.
Accessibility: paper text on #0A0A0F and #211008 meets AA+; all interactive elements are 44px minimum; screen readers announce author, time, delivery, text, attachment, and report options per message.
